title: Merchandise Purchases — Payments Operations Memo on When and How Much Payment Is Captured
content:
**When payment is captured.** For a Merchandise Purchases unit that is carried out or collected through store pickup, payment is captured on the purchase date. For a unit that is shipped or delivered to the home, payment is authorized at order and captured on the ship date; for home delivery that is the scheduled delivery date.

**How much is captured.** The amount captured for a unit is its selling price plus its sales tax, less the Finch Notes applied to it.

**Card charges.** A unit charged to a Marlowe & Finch card names the card account charged; the charge itself posts on the card account per order number.

**Finch Notes.** Finch Notes are not a tender, and are never refunded as money.

## Capture timing at a glance

| How the unit is fulfilled | Payment authorized | Payment captured |
|---|---|---|
| carry-out | — | purchase date |
| store pickup | — | purchase date |
| ship to home | at order | ship date |
| home delivery | at order | scheduled delivery date |

## Worked capture (hypothetical figures)

A unit with a selling price of $80.00, sales tax of $6.40 and $10.00 of Finch Notes applied: the amount captured is $80.00 plus $6.40, less $10.00, that is $76.40. The $10.00 of Finch Notes is never paid back to the customer as money.
